# Keep the speed in a variable.  Even though we don't change the
# value, giving it a name makes the code easier to read and easier to
# change.
speed = 4

# Likewise, keep the X and Y coordinate limits (the furthest we want
# the player to be able to go left and right, and up and down) in
# variables.
x_limit = 210
y_limit = 150

# These variables DO change as the player plays the game.  They track
# the current speed of the player in each dimension.
x_velocity = 0
y_velocity = 0

# This variable doesn't change value, but (as above) it's useful to
# give it a name.  This is the acceleration, which says how quickly
# the player's speed changes.
accel = 0.5

# Continuously check for movement keys being pressed, and adjust our X
# or Y velocity if needed, up to the "speed" limit.  If neither
# left/right key is pressed, drift the horizontal velocity
# (x_velocity) towards zero.  And if neither up/down key is pressed,
# drift the vertical velocity (y_velocity) towards zero.  Then update
# the position according to the velocity, making sure we don't go
# outside the screen limits.
while True:
    if self.key_pressed("a"):
        x_velocity -= accel
        x_velocity = max(x_velocity, -speed)
    if self.key_pressed("d"):
        x_velocity += accel
        x_velocity = min(x_velocity, speed)
    if not self.key_pressed("a") and not self.key_pressed("d"):
        if x_velocity > 0:
            x_velocity -= accel
        elif x_velocity < 0:
            x_velocity += accel

    self.change_x(x_velocity)
    self.set_x(min(x_limit, self.x_position))
    self.set_x(max(-x_limit, self.x_position))

    if self.key_pressed("s"):
        y_velocity -= accel
        y_velocity = max(y_velocity, -speed)
    if self.key_pressed("w"):
        y_velocity += accel
        y_velocity = min(y_velocity, speed)
    if not self.key_pressed("s") and not self.key_pressed("w"):
        if y_velocity > 0:
            y_velocity -= accel
        elif y_velocity < 0:
            y_velocity += accel

    self.change_y(y_velocity)
    self.set_y(min(y_limit, self.y_position))
    self.set_y(max(-y_limit, self.y_position))
